title: PLRD: Partially Linear Regression Discontinuity Inference
abstract: arXiv:2503.09907v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Regression discontinuity designs have become one of the most popular research designs in empirical economics. We argue, however, that the widely used approaches to building confidence intervals in regression discontinuity designs often exhibit suboptimal behavior in practice. We propose a new estimator, the partially linear regression discontinuity (PLRD) estimator that, in set of a simulation studies carefully calibrated to twelve high-profile applications of regression discontinuity designs, has substantially lower estimation error than available comparison methods. Throughout our experiments, the confidence intervals built using PLRD are both valid and short. We also provide large-sample guarantees for PLRD. translated_title: 部分线性回归断点推断
translated_abstract: 回归断点设计已成为实证经济学中最流行的研究设计之一。然而，我们认为，在回归断点设计中广泛使用的构建置信区间的方法在实践中往往表现不佳。我们提出了一种新的估计器——部分线性回归断点（PLRD）估计器，在一系列针对十二个高知名度回归断点设计应用精心校准的模拟研究中，该估计器的估计误差显著低于现有比较方法。在整个实验中，基于PLRD构建的置信区间既有效又短。我们还为PLRD提供了大样本保证。我们的模拟研究可作为通用模板，通过构建生成与现有替代方案不可区分的合成数据的模拟设计，来可信地评估新计量经济学方法相对于现有替代方案的表现。
tldr: 提出了一种新的部分线性回归断点（PLRD）估计器，在模拟研究中比现有方法具有更低的估计误差和更短且有效的置信区间，并提供大样本保证，为计量方法评估提供了通用模板。
en_tdlr: We propose a new partially linear regression discontinuity (PLRD) estimator that achieves lower estimation error and shorter valid confidence intervals than existing methods in calibrated simulations, with large-sample guarantees and a general evaluation template.
